title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-25
lineage: DAT (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an electrifying 1969 show highlighted by a soaring High Time, Dark Star and Pigpen front‑and‑center.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear soundboard recording made by Charlie Miller, calling it “out of this world.” The performance is praised for its high energy, with standout moments like a powerful High Time, an early Dark Star voyage, and a vibrant Pigpen presence. Overall the set flows smoothly despite being a single‑set show.

ai_rating.rationale: Both musical performance and recording quality receive high praise; only one ambiguous low rating slightly lowers certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as “out of this world” with crisp, clear mix throughout.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: One‑set show that builds from early jams into a strong Dark Star segment and climaxes with High Time; transitions praised.

band_member_comments.Keys: Two keyboards noted, adding texture to the performance
band_member_comments.Drums: Two drummers present, contributing to a thick rhythmic foundation
